{{Quote|Something's attacking my herd of staga beasts.|[[Oss Wilum]]|audio=Staga-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Staga''' were large, horned animals,<ref name="Saga of Nomi Sunrider" /> native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].<ref name="CSWE" /> They had a reptilian appearance, though some had large tufts of hair covering their backs. Their skin was [[Color/Legends|green]], and they had thick scales, a long tail and two large, curved horns. They were generally seen in packs of two dozen or so, and often stampeded, surrounded by clouds of dust. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thon]] tended to them, and kept them safely tethered outside his home. He did, however, allow them to wander during the day; he would call them back with hooting cries.<ref name="Saga of Nomi Sunrider">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Saga of Nomi Sunrider]]''</ref>

They were transported to the planet [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]<ref name="EGTPM" /> in [[2320 BBY/Legends|2320 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> where they were used as a food source for the local population.<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> Although Staga appeared relatively harmless, they had several defense mechanisms in the form of the sharp scales, which were painful for [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to touch, and their long horns. They were trainable, and [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] could ride them, but they were unruly mounts at best.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>
